content: Ařeqqeḥ n Israil
Awař nni dd-yusin zi SIDI i Irmiya, inna:
“Ammu i iqqar SIDI, AREBBI n Israil, iqqar: ‘Ari marra awařen nni d ac nniɣ deg ijj n wedlis.

Maɣar xzar, ad dd-asen wussan, ammu i iqqar SIDI, ad qeřbeɣ tameḥbast n řgens inu, Israil d Yahuda, ammu i iqqar SIDI. Necc ad ten arreɣ ɣar temmurt i wciɣ i řejdud nsen u nitni ad tt ṭṭfen d tasɣart.’”
Ina d awařen i zi issiweř SIDI x Israil d Yahuda:
“Maɣar ammu i iqqar SIDI: ‘Nesřa řḥess issiggʷaden, ijj n řḥess issnexřiɛen, war iǧi n řehna.
Seqsam u xzarem, ma izemmar weryaz ad yaruw? Mayemmi i ttwařiɣ marra iryazen s ifassen x tejɛinna nsen am yict n temɣart tᵉttaru, u qaɛ aɣembub idweř iwarɣ am řxecbet?
Uct, maɣar d ameqqran ass nni, war iǧi uřa d ijjen am netta. Ict n řweqt n řeḥṣaret i Yaɛqub, maca netta ad zzayes ittwassenjem.
Deg wass nni ad imsar, ammu i iqqar SIDI n řɛeskarat, ad arẓeɣ azayřu x yiřawen nnec. Ibarraniyyen war t ttejjin ad xasen isexxar ɛad am yismeɣ,
Nitni ad sexxaren i SIDI, AREBBI nsen, uřa i ujeǧid nsen Dawud wenni dd ɣa ssekkareɣ di ṭṭweɛ nsen.’”

“War teggʷed, a cek amsexxar inu Yaɛqub, ammu i iqqar SIDI, war tefciř ca, a Israil, maɣar xzar, Necc ad cek ssnejmeɣ zi timmura iggʷejen uřa d zzariɛet nnec zi tmeḥbast nsen. Ad yareggʷeḥ Yaɛqub, ad ɣares tiři řhudnet, ad iddar di řaman uca uřa d ijj war t issnexřiɛ.

Maɣar Necc akidek, ammu i iqqar SIDI, ḥima ad cek ssnejmeɣ, maɣar Necc ad qḍiɣ marra řegnus nni ɣar cek zuzzareɣ, maca ɛemmarṣ war cek qeṭṭiɣ, maca ad cek arebbiɣ s řeɛbar iseggden u war cek heṣṣbeɣ d amezdag.”
“Maɣar ammu i iqqar SIDI: ‘Tareẓẓit nnem war tzemmar ad teggenfa, ayezzim nnem itteqqes.
Uřa d ijj war xam issɛizz ař i cem i ɣa icfen, war ɣarem ca ddawat ḥima ad tent tegged x tḥebbuct nnem.

Marra inni tuɣa i cem ittexsen ttun cem, war xam ttseqsin, maɣar am mammec iccat řeɛdu ammu i cem wtiɣ, am yijjen i yarebban s řeqsaḥet, zi ssibbet n řmuɛṣiyyet nnem imɣaren, maɣar ddnub nnem wesɛen aṭṭas.
Mayemmi tesɣuyyud ammu x treẓẓit nnem, x řeḥriq nnem i war izemmaren ad iggenfa? Zi ssibbet n řmuɛṣiyyet nnem imɣaren, maɣar ddnub nnem wesɛen aṭṭas, Necc ggiɣ dayem man aya.
S uya, marra inni cem itteffzen, ad ttwaccen simant nsen, uca marra iɣrimen nnem ad uyuren di tmeḥbast, u inni cem ikeccḍen, ad ttwakeccḍen u marra inni cem yucaren, ad ten wceɣ d tukkarḍa.
Maɣar Necc ad cem cefneɣ u ad cem ssgenfiɣ zeg iyezzimen nnem nni i dayem wtin nitni, ammu i iqqar SIDI, minzi nitni řaɣan am ‘Tamenḍart!’, qqaren: Aqa-tt d Ṣihyun, war xas ittseqsi uřa d ijj!’”
“Ammu i iqqar SIDI: ‘Xzar, ad ssenqeřbeɣ tameḥbast n iqiḍan n Yaɛqub uca ad areḥmeɣ x tzeddiɣin nsen. Ad bnan tandint ɛawed x řxirbat nnes uca řeqṣar ad dd-idweř ɣar wemcan nnes iṣeḥḥ.
Ad zzaysen iffeɣ ijj n izři n uqadi d ict n tmijja n yewdan ifarrḥen. Necc ad ten arreɣ deg waṭṭas, nitni war dikkwiřen drus, u Necc ad asen ggeɣ řɛezz u nitni war ttwasseḥqirin ɛad.
Iḥenjiren nnes ad iřin am yinni zeg wecḥař uya uca tamesmunt nnes ad tiři zzat i wudem inu u Necc ad xeřfeɣ zeg inni i-ten iḥṣaren.
Amzemmar nnes ad zzayes yiři u Řḥakem nnes ad zzayes iffeɣ u Necc ad t-i-dd-ssqarrbeɣ u Netta ad ayi dd-yades, maɣar man Wen iǧan d aḍman s wuř nnes maḥend ad ɣari dd-yades?’, ammu i iqqar SIDI.”
“Kenniw ad ayi tiřim d řgens inu d Necc ad iřiɣ d AREBBI nwem.”
“Xzar, taḥaryaḍt n SIDI, iffeɣ-dd zzayes wesɛar, am tḥaryaḍt tezzebzib nni i ɣa ihwan x uzeǧif n iɛeffanen.
Řḥaduq n weɣḍab n SIDI war ittbeddi ca ař d igga ixarriṣen n wuř nnes uca ikemmeř i-ten. Deg uneggar n wussan ad as tfehmem.”
